recentItems.title: Syrian families count cost of back-to-school season amid economic strain
recentItems.description: In Damascus' old markets, parents on Saturday compared prices for school supplies, making the final preparations for the 2026/2027 school year.

recentItems.title: Gyirong after mudslide: Foreign journalists visit for aftermath, China's rescue efforts
recentItems.description: A group of foreign journalists visited the mudslide-devastated Gyirong Port in China's Xizang to learn about first-hand details of the aftermath and China's rescue and relief efforts on multiple fronts. #GLOBALink #Gyirong #mudslide

recentItems.title: Asia-Pacific guests explore the future of media in Shenzhen
recentItems.description: On Sept. 5, the 2026 Asia-Pacific Media Forum's Sci-Tech Innovation Achievements Exhibition opened in Qianhai, Shenzhen, bringing together 30+ tech companies and media leaders to explore how innovation is shaping the future of media.

recentItems.title: ASEAN-China cooperation key to regional stability, growth, says Malaysian National News Agency CEO
recentItems.description: Cooperation between the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and China will be key to ensuring regional stability and economic growth even as the world continues to grapple with geopolitical challenges, according to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Malaysian National News Agency (Bernama). #China #ASEAN
